ev.q: is a 2008 massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG)
two teams made up of one to four players or computer enemies on each team
Players can duel each other in the PvP arena and some houses
in a turn-based combat system, similar to collectible card games
Players take on the role of student wizards who must save the Spiral
each complete with their own set of unique spells and playstyles
they gain new badge titles and automatic increases in their base statistics
Hobbies such as training pets, fishing, and gardening require energy
